narrative.overview: VAELORA is a fitness product first: one decision dial on Home, a full-screen dark recorder on Track and an honest completion screen. The V icon from the identity sheet is the only crafted object; the interface around it is clean, athletic and modern on a warm-white or instrument-black field.
keyCharacteristics: The VAELORA Score is a ten-segment ring, one segment per ten points.
Ember is the single action and live colour; leaf, gold and steel carry conditions.
Light is a bright warm-white field with white modules; dark is instrument black.
The recorder is always a dark instrument.
Modules separate by tone and one soft shadow, not borders.
One icon family (Phosphor), regular stroke, filled when selected.

rules.name: The Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember means act or live: Start, Resume, Save, recording, the route, the selected place. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Condition Rule
rules.body: Leaf comfortable, gold acceptable, steel less suitable, wherever a condition is drawn.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Text is AA on its surface; meaningful fills hold 3:1 against their module.

rules.name: The Real Data Rule
rules.body: Rings, bars and totals draw only recorded or forecast data; no streaks or achievements.

dos: Do use the V icon from the identity sheet unchanged wherever the brand appears.
Do show the number beside every ring.
Do keep progress, totals and scores to real data.
donts: Don't redraw, simplify or recolour the V.
Don't put borders on every card or nest cards.
Don't use ember for decoration or gradient text anywhere.
Don't use em dashes in interface copy.
